correctness.rationale: For u>=2, i>=2, A=P_i, B=P_{i+1}, C=A+uB, gcd(A,B)=1. Writing N=By+Aq with y in [0,A-1], the representations lift two-coin solutions (q-Bj,y+Aj) with 0<=z<=min(q-Bj,floor((y+Aj)/u)), giving exact count sum. For 0<=p<=K+1, K=floor(A/u), this proves first threshold q_p(y)=p if floor(y/u)>=p, otherwise B+p-floor(y/u)-1. Maximizing over residue classes proves g_p=B(A+up-1)-A for p<=K and the parity-dependent first break g_{K+1}=B(2A-1) if i even and B(2A-1)-A if i odd. Independent exhaustive coin-change dynamic programming checked residue crossing and maxima on bounded (u,i) grid; no inference beyond proved range.
